nodes.name: llm.ts
nodes.summary: LLM client with multi-provider support (Anthropic SDK, OmniRoute, LiteLLM) auto-detected from environment variables, with retry logic and resilient JSON extraction that salvages truncated model output.

nodes.name: registry.ts
nodes.summary: Loads persona metadata (YAML frontmatter) from the .agents/personas directory tree and provides lookup by slug for the orchestrator.

nodes.name: structured.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for the structured-output coercion helpers (idea cards, findings, verdicts, debate messages, scores) and JSON extraction robustness.

nodes.name: structured.ts
nodes.summary: Lenient coercion of persona LLM JSON into typed domain objects, defaulting missing fields and rejecting garbage entries so the engine never crashes on malformed output.

nodes.name: writer.ts
nodes.summary: Writes the full set of markdown artifacts (spec, implementation plan, executive summary, shortlist, evidence dossier, loop log, approval sheet, decision brief) after a completed run.

nodes.name: env.ts
nodes.summary: Loads .env.local into process.env once at startup (shell exports win) and provides fail-fast access to required environment variables.

nodes.name: broker.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for DirectiveBroker covering interjection routing, broadcast semantics, round archiving, and lifecycle reset.

nodes.name: detectProvider
nodes.summary: Detects the configured LLM provider from environment variables with priority OmniRoute > LiteLLM > Anthropic, throwing if none is set.

nodes.name: callAnthropic
nodes.summary: Calls the Anthropic SDK with retry and token accounting for a single system/user message pair.

nodes.name: callOpenAICompatible
nodes.summary: Calls an OpenAI-compatible gateway (OmniRoute/LiteLLM) chat-completions endpoint with retry and token accounting.

nodes.name: callLLM
nodes.summary: Main LLM entry point dispatching to the detected provider with retry and temperature/max-token options.

nodes.name: extractJSON
nodes.summary: Extracts JSON from persona text, stripping fences and prose, and repairs truncated or unescaped payloads.

nodes.name: salvageTruncatedJSON
nodes.summary: Attempts to repair truncated or unescaped JSON by balancing braces and closing open strings.

nodes.name: loadAllPersonas
nodes.summary: Loads persona frontmatter metadata from every category directory under .agents/personas/.

nodes.name: findPersona
nodes.summary: Looks up a persona by slug across all categories.

nodes.name: toIdeaCards
nodes.summary: Coerces raw LLM JSON into IdeaCard objects, handling arrays, {ideas:[]} wrappers, aliases, and auto-ids.

nodes.name: toFindings
nodes.summary: Coerces research findings JSON into typed ResearchFinding objects with evidence confidence defaults.

nodes.name: toVerdict
nodes.summary: Coerces reviewer JSON into ReviewerVerdict objects, normalizing verdict values and feedback items.

nodes.name: toDebateMessages
nodes.summary: Coerces debate JSON into DebateMessage objects with persona fallbacks.

nodes.name: extractCriteria
nodes.summary: Extracts and validates a score-criteria map from a raw record, returning null for non-genuine score objects.

nodes.name: toScores
nodes.summary: Coerces score JSON (array or map form) into typed Score objects, rejecting garbage entries and filtering to known idea IDs.

nodes.name: writeArtifacts
nodes.summary: Writes the full eight-file markdown artifact set for a completed run to output/<slug>/.

nodes.name: renderSpec
nodes.summary: Renders the winning solution spec markdown from the event config and winner.

nodes.name: renderImplementationPlan
nodes.summary: Renders the implementation-plan markdown from the run outcome.

nodes.name: renderShortlist
nodes.summary: Renders the Top-3 shortlist table with per-criterion scores.

nodes.name: renderLoopLog
nodes.summary: Renders a chronological log of deliberation rounds for the loop-log artifact.

nodes.name: renderApprovalSheet
nodes.summary: Renders the reviewer approval sheet listing per-reviewer verdicts.

nodes.name: renderDecisionBrief
nodes.summary: Renders the decision brief summarizing the winner, dissent, and weight sensitivity.

nodes.name: loadEnv
nodes.summary: Idempotently loads .env.local into process.env without overwriting existing values.

nodes.name: requireEnv
nodes.summary: Returns a required environment variable or throws with a pointer to .env.local.

nodes.name: broker.ts
nodes.summary: DirectiveBroker routes human interjections from the control room to the targeted reviewer persona(s), tracking pending, shown, and consumed directives per deliberation round.

nodes.name: meta.ts
nodes.summary: Persona display metadata (emoji, label, chip style) kept out of components so fast-refresh only re-renders the component file.

nodes.name: idea-pool.ts
nodes.summary: IdeaPool provides Map-backed storage for candidate idea cards with add, get, remove, replace-all, and snapshot operations.

nodes.name: scoring.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the weighted scoring engine: total computation, ranking, weight merging, progress detection, and sensitivity analysis.

nodes.name: scoring.ts
nodes.summary: Weighted scoring engine that computes idea totals, ranks candidates with tie-breaking, detects round convergence, and runs sensitivity analysis to find load-bearing criteria.

nodes.name: budget-governor.ts
nodes.summary: BudgetGovernor enforces research time budgets and round caps, tracking elapsed research time, per-round timing, and remaining rounds.

nodes.name: event-bus.ts
nodes.summary: EventBus is the single source of truth for run events (emit, subscribe, replay, filter) and the globalBus singleton powers the transcript, loop log, and control-room WS stream.

nodes.name: personaMeta
nodes.summary: Returns display metadata (emoji, label, chip style) for a persona ID with a fallback entry.

nodes.name: scoreIdea
nodes.summary: Computes a weighted total score for a single idea card from criterion scores and weights.

nodes.name: rank
nodes.summary: Sorts scores by total descending (tie-broken by ideaId) and stamps rank positions.

nodes.name: sensitivityAnalysis
nodes.summary: For each criterion, drops its weight to zero and re-ranks to measure how far the winner falls, identifying load-bearing criteria.

nodes.name: roundMadeProgress
nodes.summary: Detects whether a deliberation round made progress versus the prior one by checking revisions or score movement.

nodes.name: DirectiveBroker
nodes.summary: Routes human interjections to reviewer personas: registers directives, hands them out per round, archives shown sets, and drains consumed ones.

nodes.name: IdeaPool
nodes.summary: Map-backed store for candidate idea cards with add/get/remove/replace/snapshot operations.

nodes.name: BudgetGovernor
nodes.summary: Enforces research time budgets and round caps, tracking elapsed time and remaining rounds.

nodes.name: EventBus
nodes.summary: In-memory pub/sub event bus assigning sequence numbers, with subscribe/replay/filter, backing the run transcript and WS stream.

nodes.name: stage-machine.ts
nodes.summary: StageMachine drives the run through ordered stages, emitting a stage event on the bus at each transition with current/isPast/isDone queries.

nodes.summary: CLI entry point that loads environment and config, detects the LLM provider, optionally launches the control-room server, runs the Orchestrator, and reports the outcome.

nodes.name: main.tsx
nodes.summary: React entry point that mounts the control-room App into the DOM under StrictMode.

nodes.summary: HTML normalizer that strips script/style/nav/footer/header blocks, removes tags, decodes entities, and collapses whitespace into clean readable text.
